utilityName: City of Euless Cross-Connection Control Program
testingFrequency: Test results must be submitted through TrackMyBackflow when the City program requires testing
dueBasis: Euless says Aqua Backflow contacts customers when testing is due, all backflow test results must be submitted on TrackMyBackflow.com, and tests should no longer be forwarded to the City.
coveredPropertyTypes: Water customers contacted by Aqua Backflow
Sites with backflow hazards tracked by Hazard ID or Site ID
Testers submitting reports for the Euless cross-connection program
coveredDeviceTypes: Backflow prevention assemblies tracked by Hazard ID
Irrigation-related backflow devices when assigned to the program
officialListLabel: Open Euless TrackMyBackflow tester registration details
penalties: Euless says test reports forwarded to the City will be returned. The practical compliance risk is missing the TrackMyBackflow submission, filing fee, or required Hazard ID/Site ID path.
sourceExcerpt: Euless is a strong Aqua Backflow page because the City names Aqua Backflow, TrackMyBackflow.com, tester registration, licensing and calibration upkeep, Hazard ID/Site ID entry, and a $10.95 filing fee.
verdictSummary: Euless is a strong DFW TrackMyBackflow page because the City moved reports into Aqua Backflow's portal and tells testers not to forward reports to the City.
whoIsAffected: Euless water customers and testers whose backflow assemblies are tracked by the City's Aqua Backflow/TrackMyBackflow program.
residentialNotes: Residential visibility depends on whether the customer receives an Aqua Backflow notice or has a tracked hazard.
The customer's Hazard ID or Site ID matters because the tester uses it for online entry.
commercialNotes: Commercial and managed properties should treat the portal submission as part of the test, not an afterthought.
Credential and test kit calibration records must stay current for tester access.

annualTesting.summary: Euless routes due notices and report submission through Aqua Backflow and TrackMyBackflow.
highlights: Aqua Backflow contacts customers when backflow testing is due.
All backflow test results must be submitted on TrackMyBackflow.com.
workflowSteps: Confirm the Euless notice and the Hazard ID or Site ID.
Use a tester registered with TrackMyBackflow for the Euless program.
Submit the report and filing fee through TrackMyBackflow instead of sending the report to the City.

irrigation.summary: Euless does not split irrigation into a separate public workflow on the stored page, but irrigation assemblies can still enter the same Hazard ID/Site ID reporting path when the City tracks them.
highlights: Hazard ID or Site ID should be obtained from the customer notice.
Tester credentials and calibration records must remain current.
workflowSteps: Confirm the irrigation assembly is tracked by Euless.
Use the Hazard ID or Site ID from the notice.
Confirm the notice came from the Euless/Aqua Backflow program.
Keep the Hazard ID or Site ID available for the tester.
Register or verify tester access at TrackMyBackflow.com.
Submit the completed report and filing fee through TrackMyBackflow.
failureHighlights: Reports forwarded to Euless instead of TrackMyBackflow will be returned.
Tester access depends on current licensing, certification, and test kit calibration information.
A missing Hazard ID or Site ID can slow data entry.

costBand.testingRange: Testing is market-priced by the tester.
costBand.repairRetestRange: Repair and retest costs depend on the assembly and whether a follow-up report must be filed.
costBand.pricingNotes: Euless publishes a $10.95 TrackMyBackflow filing fee.

reportWorkflow.submitter: Tester registered with TrackMyBackflow for the Euless program
reportWorkflow.acceptanceProof: Keep the TrackMyBackflow submission record; reports forwarded to the City are returned.

testerGate.deviceScopeLimit: TrackMyBackflow requires the Euless Hazard ID or Site ID before a tester can submit the result cleanly.

cadenceByPropertyType: Aqua Backflow contacts customers when Euless testing is due.
All backflow test results must be submitted on TrackMyBackflow.com.
